recipes.name: Dorm Room Chili Mac
ingredients_raw: 1 (7.25 ounce) package macaroni and cheese mix
0.25 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, or cheese of choice

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, 7 to 8 minutes.
Drain macaroni and return to the pan. Add margarine, milk, and cheese sauce packet; mix well. Stir in canned chili and cook over medium heat until hot.
Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Dorm Room Chili Mac
raw_recipe.description: Chili mac made with canned chili, boxed macaroni and cheese, and shredded Cheddar comes together quickly for a meal or snack. Perfect for a study break!

review.reviewBody: I made a super cheap version of this. I used the store brand mac n cheese, and chili spiced beans. The meal was $0.92. Not including the milk which I already had. I didn't use butter because I like my mac and cheese with out. Really good. It was better than the hamburger helper chili mac, and cheaper. Will make again.

This was excellent, but I did use vermicelli (16 oz.) and two cans of chili, one with beans and one without. Topped this with the grated cheese and chopped white onion after stirring in a couple tablespoons of butter and two teaspoons of Greek seasoning into the well-drained pasta. Very satisfying and the leftovers were great. Convenient and tasty.

i took it a lazy step further and use extreme cheese easy-mac. just microwave the easy-mac while you heat up the chili on the stove top and you're eating in five minutes!! hit it with some cholula hot sauce and it's on point
Huge hit with the boys. I used Kraft macaroni and cheese and my own homemade chili. I did add 1/2 cup of extra grated cheddar cheese to the chili mac. They loved it. No leftovers.

LOL...this was actually pretty ok!I honestly was not really inspired to cook tonight an I stumbled across this and thought id give it a shot! I did switch it up a bit though I made my own stove top mac and cheese I didnt have any boxed kind and i had leftover chili I wanted to use up also! I never keep canned chili in the house.I tossed everything together put it in a baking dish topped it with some cheddar cheese and baked it for about 30 min. It was a fast and yummy comfort meal! I will make this again for sure on my lazy nights...lol

My husband liked it, I felt it was missing something. It was fast, used on hand ingredients and was super easy to make. I added a little onion and garlic powder to the chili (Hormel with beans ). I'll make this again but add hamburger and chili beans to it instead. In a pinch, this is a good recipe to feed a family on a busy night.

This was great, especially for the price. I used Nalley Chedder Cheese Chili. Like someone suggested, I used half of the can because I wanted the cheese flavor to really stand out. I sprinkled colby jack cheese on top because that was all I had. The last thing I did was warm and cut up a couple of hot dogs to throw in! Steamed veggies on the side and it's a healthy dinner :)

Those living on a small budget and with limitied time have to appreciate this classic meal. My husband and I are both students and we make this all the time. I like to spice mine up with some chili powder, cumin, and cilantro flakes - all things I keep on hand in my spice drawer.
This was Very Good..I used Wolf Brand Chili with Beans and Velveeta Creamy Mac & Cheese for a quick lunch..We all Loved it..even My Picky 10 year old Autistic Son

This is one of my favorite dinners to make when it's just me and the kids. We all love it so much. I have made it using homemade and canned chili. Both ways are awesome! We like to make ours into a "dipper dinner" and eat this with the scoop tortilla chips. Totally delicious!

My husband absolutely adored this chili mac and he has had a lot of chili mac in his days. He said it was the cheese that made it the best...I put lots and lots of shredded cheese in it. It was great, so easy, and fast!
No
Delicious cheap quick and super easy. I added some franks buffalo wing sauce to mine to zing it up a notch

ok I took quick n easy recipe and turned it into a gourmet meal. ok. I made real macaroni n cheese and my chili from scratch and combined it up. my husband said it was definitely different but flavorful. good job!!

I've never lived in a dorm room, but I have been tight on money before. Nothing gourmet about it, but still tastes good enough to eat! I still make this now for my little brother (who is 26), he still loves food like this.
it was good! nice and easy! will keep ingredients on hand to make quickly :) only thing i would say is to add something for a little spice!

Wasn't the best, but wasn't the worst is all I can say about this recipe. I had high hopes, but the family said all it tasted like was I'd chucked some chili into kd...they've all said don't make it again :(
This is a great way to use up leftover cooked boxed mac and cheese if you don't care for the taste the next day. I pulled out some frozen chili and mixed that in. Easy, cheap, lunch

I made this with the store brand shells and cheese and a can of hormel turkey chili and beans because that's what I had on hand. My 5 year old loved. I thought it was pretty good too. A nice quick, cheap meal.
Yummy comfort food. I did use homemade chili because thats all I had on hand I also added some corn that was lurking in the fridge and some green onions for color. Good stuff.
